articles.summary: HOUSTON, Texas - September 21, 2026 - HMH Holding Inc. (NASDAQ: HMH) today announced the completion of its acquisition of Deepwater Riser Services, LLC ("DWR"), a leading provider of deepwater riser inspection, recertification, refurbishment and storage services based in Houma, Louisiana.
articles.title: HMH Completes Acquisition of Deepwater Riser Services, Deepening Its Riser Services Platform in the U.S. Gulf of America
